nodes.title: The Director's pace knob only ADDS end-of-turn silence on the realtime lane: server VAD silence_duration_ms = max(minted base 900 ms, knob), clamped 900-1200 (ENDPOINT_MIN_MS 900 in both twins, server/voice/realtimeSession.js and src/lesson/realtime.ts); VoiceLink.setPace never goes below the minted value. W2-C's knob defaults to 700 ms (840 boosted), which had set every live call to 700 ms against voice-turn-config

LinkConnection gains "stalled": VoiceLink emits it at ICE disconnected (and connected when ICE heals); only reconnect() emits "reconnecting". The runtime and the floor treat stalled as a soft state (no TeacherTurns.clear, no floor reset); useDesk starts the 4.5 s link-down clock on stalled, reconnecting or failed

After a realtime → cascade switch the client sends a resume turn (TurnRequest.laneResume) carrying the realtime turn last heard (TeacherTurns.take() BEFORE the old link closes). server/brain/turn.js accepts teacherText once on it (state.laneSwitch.resumed), stores and checks it like a voice turn (answer leak, spoiled item, floor, requireHelpline after a safeguard, floor correction), stores a system row instead of a child row, never classifies (no evidence), plans as a hold, and re-voices the planned lastMove on the cascade when it was never voiced (nothing heard, or heard cut off). Replaces the empty ASR-0 repair turn

After a lane switch the rest of the sitting keeps the character's realtime voice name (teacher.voice) on gpt-4o-mini-tts instead of DragonHD: styleForChild(..., {laneSwitched}) skips the dhd override when lesson.state.laneSwitch is set (turn prewarm, tts-stream, the prelude warm) and /api/tts Hear skips dhdHear. Voice choice stays config-driven

Lane-switch resilience: a re-mint refused for quota during reconnect (503 {fallback: cascade}) stops retrying and emits MINT_REFUSED; reconnects exhausted while navigator.onLine emit REALTIME_UNAVAILABLE (both fatal-coded, so with the switch off or impossible the lesson still fails as before); the runtime maps them to switchToCascade(mint_refused | unavailable). A switch the server refused resets laneSwitching (it can be tried again, the lesson stays on the realtime link); a switch the server took whose cascade link cannot connect fails the lesson (closed on the server) instead of leaving a dead live lesson

The first realtime RATE_LIMITED refusal is retried once (promptTeacher after max(1 s, the session's rate_limits reset hint), capped at 5 s); a second refusal within 30 s switches to cascade. A pending safeguarding hand-off never waits for the retry: the Help sheet opens and the lesson switches at once

Lane A's delivery note is verdict-blind (HV-17): realtime.js derives its row from server/voice/expressive/moment.js rowOf(m) (the cascade's own mapping: move, teacherAffect.display, engagement, safety; never the verdict) and only words each row for the realtime model; a safeguard move still never gets a note. One Moment sounds alike on both lanes

The lane-A note is inserted just BEFORE the compiled instructions' last line (withDeliveryNote), so the compiler's turn-shape rule keeps the last position; check-prompt-budget counts the longest note (174 chars, 51 tokens) on top of the worst compile. The flag stays off

TutorFace queues affect/gaze cues only on the 3D tiers, stamped; at stage boot a gaze older than 1.5 s and an affect older than 15 s are dropped; moving to a plate tier clears the queue. The face producer shows only on the 3D tiers until O1

GAZE_SELECTOR is a priority list resolved by gazeElement (first selector with a laid-out match wins, not DOM order): tray → studio-stage then tray; board → studio-stage whiteboard, chalk board, studio-stage, tray
The YOUR TURN re-ask timer in useDesk (W2-A's file, a one-line seam edit) reads state.pace.waitNudgeSec (4-30 s) once a turn carries it, else the band default (8 / 12 s)

tests/prod/w2d-voice-lanes.mjs against a local node server/serve.mjs on the Neon test branch, 2026-10-05: 22/22. Minted server VAD silence 900 ms (was 700). Resume turn after a forced switch: Director-written reply re-voicing the planned move (hook → hook), no [no speech] child row, the heard cut-off realtime turn stored with interrupted=true, a laneResume system row; her line streamed 537,600 bytes, first byte 217 ms; test account deleted

The one >5 s silence of the 4×8 min audio soak (evals/results/w2d/realtime-soak-4x8min-audio-2026-10-04.json, re-read 2026-10-05): run 1 turn 30, firstAudioMs 12,608, totalMs 14,390, status completed, no error, no rate_limits event, 4,864/5,105 input tokens cached; neighbouring turns 1.4-1.7 s. The soak talks straight to Azure's realtime WebSocket (no Taxila server in the path), so it is a service-side first-audio stall, n=1/128. The audio run's first audio is p50 2,829 / p90 3,290 ms (the text run's 1.1 s is not the audio figure); the bar of 0 silences over 5 s is NOT met, and the 4×20 min soak has not run

HV-13 re-read (evals/results/w2d/hv13-lane-a-2026-10-04.json): the base model says 'Haha' once in 40 turns in BOTH arms (note and no-note control), each time after the scripted child line 'haha pizza wala example funny tha'. So 0 sound words is NOT met as stated; the line itself added none. Open: a never-sound-word line in the realtime instructions (W2-E/W2-I compile), or accept echoing a child's laugh

Letting the vibe knob set server VAD silence directly (clamp 600-1200): W2-C's 700 ms default shortened every live call from 900 to 700 ms, reversing voice-turn-config (600 ms cut children off mid-thought) without meeting any of its reversal conditions

Reporting ICE 'disconnected' as 'reconnecting': the runtime reads that as a rebuilt call and wipes TeacherTurns, so every healed blip lost her last question before the child's answer could carry it (no leak/spoil checks, the answer graded as real evidence)

The empty ASR-confidence-0 repair turn after a lane switch: it stored a '[no speech]' child row, the server ignored the last realtime turn (the lesson was already cascade), and the Director answered with an unrelated fresh move, so the child never heard the feedback on their last answer
Lane A choosing the arc by verdict (not_yet/partial → calm → reassuring → curious): violates HV-17 and made the two lanes voice the same Moment differently; the unit test asserted the violation
